name: Shreyansh Tripathy
headline: Physics graduate with an interest in applied physics and efficient systems
bio: I am Shreyansh Tripathy, a physics graduate who likes building instruments, simulations, and small systems that make hidden behavior visible. I am drawn to applied physics: semiconductor interfaces, experimental setups, efficient systems, and the strange gap between a clean theory and the first prototype on the table. Outside the lab notebook, I am usually reading comics, playing basketball, or teaching myself another piece of code.
